item.title: On the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem
item.dc:creator: tedsanders
item.description:
The Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem asks whether smooth, globally defined solutions exist for the 3D incompressible Navier–Stokes equations with reasonable initial data. The piece explains why the question is so difficult, what solving it would mean for math and physics, and how researchers brandish partial results and new techniques in attempts to crack it. The prize carries a $1 million award from the Clay Mathematics Institute, underscoring the problem’s prestige and impact.

Navier–Stokes 千禧奖难题聚焦三维不可压缩方程在初始条件下是否存在光滑的全局解。文章解释了该问题为何极其困难、如果解决将对数学和物理带来何种影响，以及研究者如何通过部分结果和新方法推进。该奖项由克莱数学研究所提供一百万元奖金，凸显其极高的学术价值。
